seed_source: Node crypto.randomBytes(32), drawn once before replay or availability screening
method: Proportional tour quotas by Hamilton largest remainder; tie category lexicographic. Within each tour take lowest SHA256(seed + newline + category + newline + event_id); no outcome, span, or tape-availability screening.
scope: Only selected identities may execute; no redraw or tuning. The other 704 are unrun by this order. This is not a claim that they were historically unseen.
